source: Testnet blocks 299160-299230 (the minimum-difficulty rule starts at 299188), read 2026-09-11 from a local zebrad 6.3.0 Testnet node (tools/regtest/zcash-testnet-up.sh) over its internal RPC: getblockhash, then getblock <hash> 0 for the raw block and getblock <hash> 1 for the txid list. Each header is the first 1487 bytes of the raw block; its SHA-256d was checked against getblock's hash and each header's hashPrevBlock against the one below. txids are in display order.
